Hi agent! If you need to work with the horsies Rust crate, consider using the docs locally.

# Horsies (Rust)
> The Rust client of the horsies core: a PostgreSQL-backed background task queue and workflow engine.
> Docs: https://suleymanozkeskin.github.io/horsies/rust/
> Source: https://github.com/suleymanozkeskin/horsies/tree/main/crates/horsies
> Crates: horsies, horsies-macros, horsies-core

The Python client and the Rust client run on one core (horsies-core). Behaviour and guarantees are on the shared pages, for both clients. The Rust pages state the API of the crate. A database belongs to one client: the core refuses a database that the Python client installed.

## Rust API pages
- Overview -> /horsies/rust/
- App Config -- Horsies::new, with_schema_mode (MigrateAndValidate, ObserveOnly, AssumeInitialized), with_handle, AppConfig fields, Rust-only refusals (pool size bounds, preload), queues, register, provide, discover, AppRole, suppress_sends / HORSIES_SUPPRESS_SENDS -> /horsies/rust/configuration/app-config/
- Defining Tasks -- #[horsies::task], #[horsies::blocking_task], execution = isolated | shared_async | shared_thread, timeout_ms, cancel_grace_ms, retry_policy + auto_retry_for, the generated module, TaskRuntime (state, cancelled, is_cancelled, spawn, task_handle), async_task_fn!, blocking_task_fn! -> /horsies/rust/tasks/defining-tasks/
- Task Errors -- TaskError<E>, TaskErrorCode<E> (Library, User), #[derive(horsies::UserErrorCode)], with_data (never fails; data_refused), ExceptionRecord, SubWorkflowFailure, WORKER_SERIALIZATION_ERROR for input and return read-back -> /horsies/rust/tasks/errors/
- Sending Tasks -- TaskFunction<A, T, E>: send, schedule(WholeSeconds), send_with_options, schedule_with_options, with_options; TaskSendOptions (good_until, idempotency_key, retention, retain_forever); SendRetention; TaskSendError catalog; retry_send, retry_schedule; resend_on_transient_err; PayloadPolicy -> /horsies/rust/tasks/sending-tasks/
- Retrieving Results -- TaskHandle::get(WaitLimit) -> Result<TaskOutcome<T, E>, ReadError>; kept reads; info(TaskInfoParts); app.task_handle_of, get_result, get_raw_result (StoredResult), get_task_info -> /horsies/rust/tasks/retrieving-results/
- Health Reads -- ping_database, ping_workers(PingTarget, timeout, min_responses), list_worker_states, get_worker_state, get_worker_state_history(WorkerHistoryLimit), get_stale_tasks(StaleMinutes), get_expired_tasks, BoundedTaskList (Complete, Truncated; TASK_LIST_BOUND 10,000), get_class_coverage, get_class_report -> /horsies/rust/monitoring/health-reads/

Not written yet (tracked in https://github.com/suleymanozkeskin/horsies/issues/1412): quick start, blocking API, workflow API, typed node builder, subworkflows, worker setup, schedule config, monitoring queries, web UI mount, rerun in your transaction, async frameworks, testing, CLI reference, switching to 0.8.0.
